explanation: The physical food that Jesus distributed to feed the thousands, as well as a symbol of his own body given for the life of the world.
A title Jesus uses for himself to describe his role as the only source of eternal and true spiritual life.
The deep human need for meaningful existence and God's presence, something that only the water from Christ can quench.
Trust and surrender to Jesus as the Messiah, an action necessary to receive eternal life rather than merely temporary miracles.
A description of how the Son of Man was lifted up on the cross to reveal God's love and draw all people to himself.
The gift of an infinite, perfect existence in fellowship with God, given through faith in Jesus Christ.
